items.title: AST SpaceMobile Stock Crash: Why ASTS shares plunged 11% as SpaceX eyes Boost Mobile
items.excerpt: AST SpaceMobile shares hit a 52-week low of $36.72 amid growing concerns over competition in the satellite-to-smartphone connectivity market. The stock has fallen nearly 73% from its 52-week high of $133.86, reflecting mounting investor concerns about the company's growth prospects and competitive positioning. (Sources: Investing.com, TradingView, Reuters) ​AST SpaceMobile Stock Hits 52-Week Low of $36.72

items.title: AST SpaceMobile announces new 'Blacklift' rocket, targets 2028 launch debut
items.excerpt: AST SpaceMobile plans to launch its broadband satellites on a new rocket called Blacklift, which it will build in house and plans to start flying in 2028.
